pitch:
The Bhubaneswar Founding Salon Plan: your salon, live on your phone, set up in one visit, with a person who answers.
Your salon's own Android app (your name and logo) on your phone and every stylist's phone, installed by us. Stylists bill a walk-in in about a minute (cash, UPI, card or prepaid wallet) and send the bill on WhatsApp with one tap; a customer who won't give a number can still be billed. It keeps working when the internet drops. Unlimited staff.
You see from anywhere who is in which chair right now (a live view of your salon), today's takings, and daily checks: cancelled bills, customers who left without service, and the cash that should be in the drawer. Your customers get due-back reminders, a prepaid wallet, ₹100 for bringing a friend, and a request for a Google review after each visit.
Included: we set it up in one half-day visit at a quiet time, type in your existing customer list from your register or old app (up to 500 customers, with wallet balances), and train every stylist at the salon in Odia, Hindi or English, with a one-page guide. A named person answers by phone or WhatsApp 7 days a week, festival weeks included. Your data is backed up online and you can download all of it any time, even if you stop. No WhatsApp charges, no extra fees, cancel from inside the app.
Price: ₹10,000 for setup, paid in two halves: ₹5,000 on setup day and ₹5,000 after 30 days, only if your stylists are billing in the app on at least 20 working days of that month; if not, we come back to fix it, or you stop and get your ₹5,000 back. Then ₹500 a month, locked for 2 years. The first 5 Bhubaneswar salons (all one person can set up and support well this month) also get the first 3 months' monthly fee free, in return for letting one or two nearby owners see the app in their salon. All prices in Indian rupees.
